text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: conjunction opening the observed solar scene as continuation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes from the prior refuge command into visible fulfillment. The scene is not introduced as a detached nature note; it carries the reader forward into the promised shelter being shown in operation.

topics.headline: continued visual frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the solar description continues the refuge narrative rather than starting a separate scenic aside.
topics.reason: The conjunction and transition rows both attach the opening to the prior command scene and its observed fulfillment.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person seeing that invites repeatable observation and reflection
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, considering, and forming judgment; locally visual observation opens into sign-reading
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) puts the listener in the position of an observer. Its imperfect second-person form makes the solar arrangement inspectable and repeatable, while the seeing root allows the visible scene to become a basis for judgment. The observer who sees the sign is later addressed again in the denied finding clause, so perception and theological inference stay joined.

topics.headline: repeatable observation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave protection is presented as something one can keep observing, not only as a past report.
topics.reason: The imperfect second-person grammar and visual-reflective root rows converge on repeatable observation as the local entry into the sign.

topics.headline: observer and seeing pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from the youths inside the story to an outside witness who reads the sun as evidence.
topics.reason: The observer-shift, sun co-occurrence, surah motif, and fulfillment rows survive as contextual payoff without changing the verb parse.

words.gloss_range: definite direct object and continuing feminine solar subject
words.root_gloss_range: radiance and solar force; resistant-energy associations are only background pressure, not the selected sense
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) is the familiar sun made into the visible object and then the continuing actor of both solar clauses. Its definiteness lets an ordinary shared cosmic body become the marked instrument of protection and a sign-reading object. The radiance field matters because light itself becomes the medium by which concealment is arranged, while resistant-energy associations remain secondary lexical pressure rather than a new local meaning. Even the solar-letter assimilation suits a word whose solar motion is being described.

topics.headline: definite solar actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one familiar sun carries the whole two-part protective movement.
topics.reason: The direct-object grammar, definiteness, and shared-subject rows identify the sun as the single actor of the diptych.

topics.headline: radiance and resistant force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protective sign uses the force of sunlight itself while hints of untamable energy stay only as lexical background.
topics.reason: V4-style lexical range allows radiance and resistant-force pressure, but local grammar selects the concrete sun rather than an animal or moralized sense.

topics.headline: sign-reading and sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun is already a sign-reading object and even the solar-letter assimilation suits the scene.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence, later horizon, and phonetic rows add local texture without competing with the main solar-agent topic.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional adverb marking certain recurrence at sunrise
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) turns sunrise into a recurring condition. With the perfect verb that follows, it favors a reliable whenever-pattern, and its first position prepares the matching second temporal clause.

topics.headline: recurring sunrise condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sunrise is grammatically part of a patterned cycle, not an accidental timestamp.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb, following perfect verb, and paired-clause rows all support realized recurrence within the solar frame.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I rising in the first temporal condition
words.root_gloss_range: rising, emerging, and coming into view; locally ordinary sunrise, with exposure imagery as lexical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:طَلَعَتْ}} ({{tr:ṭalaʿat}}) gives the ordinary rising event that triggers the marked swerving verb. The perfect after the temporal adverb makes the action habitual in the daily cycle. The root's emergence field sharpens the scene: exposure begins, then is immediately disciplined by the sun's turning away.

topics.headline: habitual rising frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary sunrise is one half of a repeated bracket around the sleepers.
topics.reason: Agreement with the sun, perfect-after-temporal grammar, Form I intransitivity, and the rising-setting antithesis all support the frame.

topics.headline: emergence pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sunrise as an emergence into view, while botanical and cognitive branches remain only range pressure.
topics.reason: The local Form I solar verb selects rising, but the root rows validly add exposure and emergence texture without activating all domains.

words.gloss_range: Form VI imperfect swerving away from the cave in the sunrise half
words.root_gloss_range: visiting, inclining aside, deviating, and falsifying; locally the motion sense is a deliberate turn-aside, not moral falsehood
words.prose: {{ar:تَّزَٰوَرُ}} ({{tr:tazāwaru}}) is the first strongly marked motion word. After ordinary rising, the sun is portrayed as turning itself aside from the cave, with Form VI, the compressed surface from the doubled-t form, and the transmitted variants keeping the action morphologically vivid. The root's visit-and-deviation field lets the movement feel like an approach that becomes non-contact, but the falsehood branch is only an image of skewing away, not a moral accusation. Its pairing with the later cutting verb makes routine solar time into a protective mechanism, and the sibilant-glide-roll sound contour supports the curl of the swerving motion.

topics.headline: marked swerving motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sunrise movement as a deliberate turn-aside from the cave, not just a neutral change of direction.
topics.reason: The local Form VI verb and separation frame select swerving aside; broader visiting and falsifying senses survive only as imagistic pressure.

topics.headline: variant and surface compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tradition preserves this turning action as morphologically intense, while the main reading still governs the local parse.
topics.reason: Accepted variant data can illuminate intensity and form debate, but the canonical Form VI surface remains the controlling local form.

topics.headline: protective diptych pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the asymmetric protection: sunrise avoids by separation while sunset acts with a cutting pass.
topics.reason: The structural rows explicitly pair the swerving verb with the later cutting verb as the mechanism of the solar diptych.

topics.headline: phonetic swerving texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound contour supports the curl of the swerving motion.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows add recitational texture to the same retained swerving topic without controlling sense.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: preposition of separation after the swerving verb
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) supplies the separation that makes the sunrise movement protective. The sun does not simply move near the cave; the syntax directs the movement away from it before the cave is named.

topics.headline: separation from cave
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that avoidance is built into the prepositional grammar, not inferred only from the story.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the cave phrase and is required by the swerving construction, so both rows support separation.

words.gloss_range: possessed cave governed by the separation preposition
words.root_gloss_range: shelter, cave, and spacious refuge; locally a concrete inhabited refuge, not a generic cave symbol
words.prose: {{ar:كَهْفِهِمْ}} ({{tr:kahfihim}}) is both the object from which the sun swerves and the place now possessed by the sleepers. The attached pronoun makes the commanded refuge into their inhabited shelter. The cave-root's spacious-refuge range prepares the later interior opening, while its concentration in Surah 18 makes the setting a surah-specific theological marker.

topics.headline: possessed refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refuge has become the sleepers’ own inhabited place.
topics.reason: The genitive construction and attached plural pronoun bind place and inhabitants in one local form.

topics.headline: spacious shelter range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave can shelter without sealing, preparing the open interior named later.
topics.reason: The local noun remains concrete cave/refuge, while the lexical range supports breadth-within-shelter as a valid pressure.

topics.headline: surah-specific cave root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave word anchors this surah’s distinctive setting rather than functioning as common scenery.
topics.reason: The recurrence and count rows support a Surah 18 setting signal without altering the grammar.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct adverbial marking the right-side domain
words.root_gloss_range: possession and sidedness; locally an adverbial directional construct
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتَ}} ({{tr:dhāta}}) frames the right side as a directional domain. Its construct shape makes direction feel like belonging to a side, and the same construction returns for the left side. The row linking this directional grammar to later horizon movement (18:86) survives as a geography echo, while the adjacent return in 18:18 keeps the cave axis active.

topics.headline: directional construct domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right side is expressed as a sided domain, not a bare compass label.
topics.reason: The accusative adverbial and construct evidence support sidedness as the local grammatical payoff.

topics.headline: geography and turning echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cave orientation participates in the surah’s larger directional field (18:86) and prepares bodily turning (18:18).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references, so the echo is retained without letting it control the local parse.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive right side in the solar diptych
words.root_gloss_range: right side, strength, oath, and blessing; locally spatial right side with favorable pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَمِينِ}} ({{tr:al-yamīni}}) names the right side that closes the sunrise half. The spatial sense is local and primary, but the root's strength, oath, and blessing associations give the side favorable pressure. Its pairing with the left side makes the cave protection a right-left envelope, continued with the sleepers’ own turning in 18:18.

topics.headline: favorable right side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right side is spatially local while carrying favorable lexical pressure.
topics.reason: The local construction selects direction; broader oath and blessing senses are retained only as controlled connotation.

topics.headline: right-left envelope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that right and left together form a total protective axis, later applied to the sleepers in 18:18.
topics.reason: The binary-pair and same-surah recurrence rows make the right side part of the complete spatial frame.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the sunset condition with the sunrise condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second temporal condition to the first. It prevents the sunset clause from becoming a new scene; the two halves form one periodic protective construction.

topics.headline: coordinated solar cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sunrise and sunset must be read as one designed cycle.
topics.reason: Both rows describe coordination of the paired temporal construction.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: second temporal-conditional adverb mirroring the first
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) repeats the temporal frame for the other horizon. The repetition makes sunset structurally equivalent to sunrise and confirms the habitual bracket around the cave.

topics.headline: paired temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sunrise-sunset bracket rather than two isolated time notes.
topics.reason: The repeated temporal adverb and matched-position rows all support a habitual paired frame.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I setting in the second temporal condition
words.root_gloss_range: setting, western distance, foreignness, and edge; locally ordinary sunset with edge imagery
words.prose: {{ar:غَرَبَتْ}} ({{tr:gharabat}}) mirrors the earlier rising verb as the ordinary setting half of the cycle. Its root points to the far side or horizon-edge, and that edge pressure resonates with the following cutting verb without replacing the local sense of sunset. The same western field later expands in the horizon episode (18:86).

topics.headline: cyclic setting frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sunset is as patterned and ordinary as sunrise, before the marked action that follows.
topics.reason: The perfect-after-temporal frame, Form I intransitivity, and rising-setting antithesis support the cyclic setting topic.

topics.headline: far-edge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sunset as movement to the far edge, sharpening the next cutting image while staying within the local setting sense.
topics.reason: The edge and sharpness rows are valid lexical pressure, but the local verb remains the simple intransitive sunset verb.

topics.headline: western horizon echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local sunset language anticipates the surah’s later solar geography (18:86).
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah horizon reference, so it survives as an echo without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect cutting or passing by with attached object pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: cutting, passing by, and lending; locally physical cutting-past or grazing, with lending as secondary resonance
words.prose: {{ar:تَّقْرِضُهُمْ}} ({{tr:taqriḍuhum}}) is the sunset counterpart to the swerving verb. Unlike the sunrise avoidance through a preposition, this verb takes the sleepers as a direct object, so the sun's passing is grammatically aimed at them. The root gives a concrete cut-or-graze image and, by contrast with the common loan formula, keeps the physical Form I sense primary; lending and extinction associations survive only as controlled resonance. The clipped sound and the combined sunrise-sunset mechanics make protection happen through precise non-contact.

topics.headline: direct protective bypass
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sunset acts directly on the sleepers’ side while still sparing them through a passing cut.
topics.reason: Agreement with the sun, the direct object suffix, and the contrast with prepositional avoidance make the bypass locally central.

topics.headline: cut-pass root range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sharp passing action that protects by not consuming, while lending remains a secondary resonance.
topics.reason: The local Form I solar verb selects physical cutting or passing; broader lending and extinction branches are narrowed to imagistic pressure.

topics.headline: form register and variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare physical use differs from the more common loan register, while variant agreement does not overturn the main reading.
topics.reason: Form I versus Form IV evidence is decisive for local sense; variant agreement is retained as apparatus-level flexibility.

topics.headline: sound and combined mechanics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sharp sound, avoidance, cutting, and spacious interior combine into a concrete protective system.
topics.reason: The phonetic and synthesis rows preserve how multiple lexical domains jointly produce the protection payoff.

words.gloss_range: repeated accusative construct adverbial for the left side
words.root_gloss_range: possession and sidedness; locally the same directional construction as the right side
words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتَ}} ({{tr:dhāta}}) repeats the same directional construction for the left side. The repeated form makes the two sides grammatically symmetrical and presents the solar avoidance as systematic design.

topics.headline: repeated directional construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that right and left are deliberately matched in form.
topics.reason: All rows identify the repeated construct as a formal parallel within the solar diptych.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive left side closing the second solar half
words.root_gloss_range: left side, encompassing, wrapping, and north-wind associations; locally spatial left side with enclosure pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشِّمَالِ}} ({{tr:al-shimāli}}) closes the second temporal clause as the left-side counterpart to the right side. The local sense is directional, but the root's encompassing and wrapping pressure strengthens the image of a completed spatial envelope around the sleepers. The same axis returns in 18:18 when the sleepers themselves are turned right and left.

topics.headline: left enveloping side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the left side completes an enveloping field, while the local sense remains spatial direction.
topics.reason: The left-side construction selects direction; encompassing and wind associations are valid but narrowed lexical pressure.

topics.headline: completed spatial envelope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun cannot reach the cave from either side, and the same axis governs the sleepers in 18:18.
topics.reason: The binary-pair, clause-endpoint, and adjacent-verse rows make the left side the close of the protective axis.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction introducing the sleepers’ simultaneous state
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) shifts from moving sun to simultaneous human stillness. As a circumstantial conjunction, it holds the sleepers’ interior state inside the same sentence as the solar choreography. The audience watches a protected state that the sleepers themselves do not narrate.

topics.headline: circumstantial simultaneity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleepers’ state is simultaneous with the moving solar protection.
topics.reason: The circumstantial nominal-clause evidence and the static-interior versus moving-sun row converge on simultaneity.

topics.headline: observer and sleepers frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audience watching what the sleepers themselves do not narrate.
topics.reason: The observer/sleepers row adds viewpoint payoff to the same circumstantial frame.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun subject of the interior state clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) explicitly centers the sleepers before the inner space is named. The grammar reads the cave geography in relation to the people being preserved, marking a shift from their earlier responsibility to God's preservation of them.

topics.headline: beneficiaries foregrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protected people, not the cave as scenery, are foregrounded in the state clause.
topics.reason: The explicit pronoun, clause position, and narrative-shift rows all support beneficiary focus.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: preposition of containment governing the inner opening
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) marks containment. The sleepers are not merely near the cave but inside an interior zone where enclosure, openness, and cave-reference work together.

topics.headline: contained interior zone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that protection is spatially interior, not just adjacent to the cave.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the interior noun and links enclosure with the cave arrangement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite inner opening or spacious recess inside the cave
words.root_gloss_range: wide opening, gap, or spacious interior; locally openness within enclosure
words.prose: {{ar:فَجْوَةٍ}} ({{tr:fajwatin}}) names the cave's protective paradox: open space inside enclosure. Its indefiniteness leaves the exact recess unclassified, while its hapax status makes this interior lexically singular. The promised mercy of 18:16 becomes visible as geometry: not sealed confinement, but breathable protected space.

topics.headline: open space within enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave protects by combining enclosure with breathable openness.
topics.reason: The lexical, grammar, and cave/fajwa synthesis rows converge on openness-within-enclosure as the main payoff.

topics.headline: indefinite hapax interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the specific interior space is unnamed and lexically unique in the Quran.
topics.reason: The indefiniteness, tanwin, and hapax rows give formal specificity to the interior space.

topics.headline: fulfilled refuge geometry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earlier refuge command is realized as visible spatial protection in 18:17.
topics.reason: The boundary row explicitly connects the commanded refuge to the materialized cave geometry.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: preposition plus singular pronoun referring to the cave as source or interior frame
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) ties the inner opening back to the cave. The singular pronoun most directly points to the cave, separating the protected people from the spatial source that shelters them; a wider design-reading can be felt, but the cave referent remains the local anchor.

topics.headline: cave-source pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the open space belongs to the cave itself, while a providential design resonance remains secondary.
topics.reason: QAC and grammar identify the cave as the direct singular referent; wider design readings are narrowed to contextual resonance.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative gathering the completed solar-cave scene
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) is the hinge from scene to meaning. It gathers the whole solar diptych and protected interior into a single demonstrative, then turns that seen arrangement into theological evidence and the basis for the guidance maxim.

topics.headline: demonstrative discourse pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the physical arrangement is gathered and interpreted as one sign before the guidance rule begins.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative, narrator-evaluation, whole-scene, and synthesis rows all support the pivot from description to doctrine.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: partitive preposition classifying the scene among signs
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) classifies the gathered scene as one from among divine signs. The description is formally converted into evidence rather than left as scenery.

topics.headline: partitive sign classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cave event is one member of a larger class of divine signs.
topics.reason: The partitive predicate and interpretive-hinge rows both support formal classification as evidence.

words.gloss_range: plural construct signs bound to the divine name
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, evidence, and recited verse; locally visible evidence owned by God, with root derivation disputed
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِ}} ({{tr:āyāti}}) promotes the physical solar-cave arrangement into signs of God. The plural keeps this event within a larger sign-system, and the construct grammar assigns source and ownership to God. The word can hold sign, verse, and evidence together even though root derivation is disputed; the local payoff is visible evidence that belongs to God’s argument across the surah.

topics.headline: divine sign construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the event is not autonomous natural mechanics but one sign among God’s signs.
topics.reason: Plural construct grammar and the following divine name support sign ownership and larger class membership.

topics.headline: sign verse evidence range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene functions as visible evidence and Quranic verse without depending on one contested derivation.
topics.reason: The sign/evidence range is locally active, while root-derivation dispute prevents overclaiming a single etymology.

topics.headline: surah sign argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this cave sign joins the surah’s wider argument about warning, denial, and evidence.
topics.reason: The surah recurrence row gives broader discourse provenance without creating a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name completing the signs construct
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; etymological dispute does not affect local proper-name force
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct: the signs belong to God. The divine name retains proper-name force without depending on one etymology. This also sets up the later exclusivity of patronage: the one named as sign-owner here is the one whose exclusive guardianship is affirmed elsewhere in the surah (18:26; 18:44).

topics.headline: divine owner of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the observed protection is assigned to God as sign-owner.
topics.reason: The construct completion and boundary row make divine ownership of the sign locally explicit.

topics.headline: proper name with root dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the theological claim rests on the divine name’s proper force, not on a single etymological theory.
topics.reason: The root-dispute row is valid as a guardrail: it narrows etymological use while leaving the proper name active.

topics.headline: patronage exclusivity echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial of any other patron-guide in 18:17 aligns with divine patronage claims in 18:26 and 18:44.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete same-surah references linking the divine name with later patronage exclusivity.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: conditional particle introducing the first universal branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) moves from the specific cave sign into a universal conditional. It governs the jussive guidance verb and forms the first half of a matched pair, so the maxim applies beyond the sleepers and sets up the guidance-misguidance binary.

topics.headline: universal conditional binary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign turns into an exhaustive rule about whoever is guided or misled.
topics.reason: The conditional particle, jussive governance, repeated branch, and paired-conditional rows all support universal binary force.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form I divine guiding verb under the conditional particle
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, gifting, and sacrificial leading; locally guidance/leading, with gift and offering branches as narrowed pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِ}} ({{tr:yahdi}}) is grammatically marked by the conditional frame: the shortened jussive form makes divine guidance part of the universal rule. The root keeps a concrete path-leading image continuous with the directed solar paths, while gift and offering branches add bestowed-guidance pressure without replacing the local sense. Its root link to the later guided participle and its opposition to the misguidance verb make the maxim lexically tight.

topics.headline: conditional divine guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is grammatically inside the universal conditional, not a loose description.
topics.reason: The conditional governance and apocopated jussive rows make the guidance verb formally conditional.

topics.headline: guidance root richness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as directed leading that can feel bestowed, while sacrificial and gift branches remain controlled background.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb selects guiding/leading; broader gift and offering branches are retained as semantic pressure only.

topics.headline: guidance link and antonym
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine guiding produces the guided identity and prepares the opposite misguidance branch.
topics.reason: The Form I to Form VIII link, antonym pair rows, and surah theme all join this verb to the final binary.

words.gloss_range: explicit nominative divine subject of the guidance verb
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name as active subject; etymology is not locally at issue
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) explicitly names the agent of guidance. The subject is not left implicit: the God who owns the signs is the one who gives guidance, answering the prior withdrawal from non-God worship in 18:16.

topics.headline: explicit guidance agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance agency is directly assigned to God.
topics.reason: The nominative subject rows and repetition after sign ownership make explicit divine agency central.

topics.headline: non-God withdrawal answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the youths’ withdrawal from non-God worship in 18:16 is answered by active divine guidance in 18:17.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies the concrete narrative link to the previous ayah.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: apodosis marker linking the first condition to its result
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the result of the first conditional. Guided status follows immediately as the logical consequence of God’s guidance.

topics.headline: immediate positive result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided identity follows without narrative delay from divine guidance.
topics.reason: Both rows identify the particle as the apodosis marker joining condition and result.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: independent pronoun focusing the guided person in the result clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) focuses the one guided by God as the subject of a nominal result clause. The outcome is presented as stable identity rather than a passing action.

topics.headline: focused guided identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result clause identifies the guided person with emphasis and stability.
topics.reason: The explicit pronoun and nominal-clause rows support focused identification.

words.gloss_range: definite Form VIII active participle naming the truly guided one
words.root_gloss_range: guided state and participation in guidance; locally a definite participial identity produced by divine guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadī}}) names the result as a definite guided identity. The article and participial Form VIII shape make the person not merely one guided example but the truly guided one, with guidance appropriated as a state. The root echo with the earlier guiding verb locks divine action and human condition together, and the same guidance theme answers the later dependence prayer in 18:24. The transmitted pause or full-yāʾ detail keeps that guided identity audibly marked at the branch close.

topics.headline: definite guided identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exclusive identification: this is the guided one, not merely someone described as guided.
topics.reason: Definiteness, predicate position, and participial morphology support the identity claim.

topics.headline: Form VIII guided state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as an entered or appropriated condition, while not making human self-action independent of divine guidance.
topics.reason: Form VIII participation is locally meaningful, but the preceding divine guiding verb keeps God as the producing agent.

topics.headline: guidance root echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same guidance root moving from God’s act to human state and resonating with the dependence prayer in 18:24.
topics.reason: The intra-branch root repetition and concrete 18:24 comparison preserve the root echo as commentary-relevant.

topics.headline: recitational branch close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided identity remains audibly marked at the branch close.
topics.reason: The recitational row adds branch-close texture without changing the lexical sense.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second conditional branch
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the negative conditional to the positive one. Misguidance is presented as the direct counterpart of guidance, not as a separate topic.

topics.headline: coordinated negative branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second maxim belongs to the same binary frame.
topics.reason: Both rows identify coordination of the guidance and misguidance branches.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: second conditional particle mirroring the first branch
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) repeats the conditional scope for the misguided case. The same universal grammar now covers the negative branch, turning the particular refuge scene into general guidance doctrine.

topics.headline: mirrored negative conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative branch has the same universal reach as the positive branch.
topics.reason: The repeated conditional particle, mirrored syntax, and boundary row support general theological scope.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form IV causative misguidance verb under the second conditional
words.root_gloss_range: straying, disappearing, being lost, and perishing; locally caused straying with loss-from-sight pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يُضْلِلْ}} ({{tr:yuḍlil}}) gives the negative branch a causative form. The conditional person is syntactically fronted rather than restated as object, keeping focus on the act and its consequence. The root adds concrete loss from sight and perishing pressure, which fits the coming impossibility of finding a patron-guide. Its opposition to the guidance root and the parallel warning in 18:57 make the branch a doctrine of irrecoverable misguidance, not merely a neutral path contrast.

topics.headline: caused misguidance grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misguidance is cast as caused straying under the same conditional grammar as guidance.
topics.reason: The jussive governance, fronted object relation, and Form IV causative evidence make the grammar central.

topics.headline: loss root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices misguidance as being lost from recoverable sight, while perishing remains lexical pressure rather than the sole local sense.
topics.reason: The local verb selects caused misguidance; disappearing and perishing branches are retained as controlled semantic pressure.

topics.headline: guidance misguidance opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the guidance and misguidance roots as a major antonym pair, with 18:57 echoing irremediable misguidance.
topics.reason: The antonym-pair rows and concrete 18:57 comparison make the negative branch structurally inseparable from the positive branch.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: apodosis marker linking misguidance to the negated result
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the consequence of the second conditional. The lack of any patron-guide follows directly from the act of misguidance.

topics.headline: negative result link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied helper-guide is structurally tied to misguidance.
topics.reason: Both rows identify the particle as the negative branch apodosis marker.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: future-negation particle governing the following finding verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَن}} ({{tr:lan}}) forecloses the future search. It governs the following subjunctive and places the final patron-guide phrase under emphatic negation, so the ayah ends in impossibility rather than mere present absence.

topics.headline: emphatic future foreclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the search for an alternative patron-guide is grammatically closed off into the future.
topics.reason: The negation particle, subjunctive governance, future impossibility, and final-object framing rows all support categorical foreclosure.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form I finding verb addressed to the observer
words.root_gloss_range: finding, experiencing, and existing; locally the direct act of finding is negated, with availability pressure from the wider root
words.prose: {{ar:تَجِدَ}} ({{tr:tajida}}) returns to the second-person address frame: the observer who can see the sign will not find an alternative guide for the misguided. The following negation governs the verb, and the root’s finding, experiencing, and existence range makes the denied patron-guide unavailable in practice, not merely hard to locate. The verb governs the closing phrase that defines exactly what is missing and joins the surah’s wider pattern of discoveries and absences.

topics.headline: addressed impossible finding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressee invited to see is told no alternative guide can be found.
topics.reason: The address-frame, subjunctive-after-negation, simple finding, and final-object rows support the impossible search.

topics.headline: finding experience existence range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the denied helper as unfound and effectively unavailable, while existence language remains root pressure.
topics.reason: The local construction negates finding; experience and existence branches are narrowed to availability pressure.

topics.headline: surah discovery pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this final negation joins the surah’s wider pattern of what can and cannot be found.
topics.reason: The surah recurrence row supplies discourse provenance without changing the local syntax.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun marking the person for whom help is absent
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) foregrounds the person affected by the negation. The absence is not abstract; it is for the one whom God has misled, before the indefinite patron-guide phrase is named.

topics.headline: personalized absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack of a patron-guide is personal to the misguided one.
topics.reason: The beneficiary/possessor preposition and preposed pronoun rows support personal foregrounding.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative patron object under negated finding
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, authority, protection, patronage, and guardianship; locally any protective patron, denied exhaustively
words.prose: {{ar:وَلِيًّا}} ({{tr:waliyyan}}) is the first half of the final denied object phrase. Its indefiniteness under negation makes the denial exhaustive: no patron of any kind is available. The root begins from nearness and extends to protective authority, so the missing figure would have to be near enough and powerful enough to protect; paired with the final adjective, both patronage and right-guidance are denied together. Same-surah patronage theology confirms that the denial is not merely social (18:26; 18:44).

topics.headline: exhaustive patron denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation excludes any patron who could also guide.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness, accusative object function, adjective pairing, and tanwin under negation support exhaustive denial.

topics.headline: nearness authority protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied patron would need nearness that confers protective authority.
topics.reason: The root range from proximity to guardianship is locally relevant but narrowed to the patron noun under negation.

topics.headline: divine patronage field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial of a patron apart from God anticipates the surah’s explicit patronage claims (18:26; 18:44).
topics.reason: The theological-field and same-surah recurrence rows make patronage more than a social helper category.

words.gloss_range: indefinite Form IV active participle modifying the denied patron
words.root_gloss_range: right direction, sound judgment, and causing right guidance; locally an active guide adjective joined to the patron noun
words.prose: {{ar:مُّرْشِدًا}} ({{tr:murshidan}}) completes the ayah on the absent guide. As a Form IV active participle, it names someone who actively causes right direction, not simply someone personally upright. It also brings a second guidance root beside the earlier guidance language, so the final denial says the misguided person lacks both protective patronage and practical right-direction. The final position and paired accusative cadence make that absence the ayah's closing sound.

topics.headline: active right-guiding role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing figure would have to actively direct rightly, not merely offer generic help.
topics.reason: The adjective/circumstantial syntax, Form IV active participle, and lexical right-direction rows support the active guiding role.

topics.headline: two guidance roots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies a practical right-guidance root after affirming divine path-guidance.
topics.reason: The rows contrast the two guidance roots and locate the right-guidance root within the surah’s prayer and instruction scenes.

topics.headline: ayah-final absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on the absent guide, with the final paired cadence binding patron and guide as jointly missing.
topics.reason: The final-position and cadence rows preserve the rhetorical close of the negative branch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rising sun turns aside from the cave to the right, the setting sun passes them on the left, and they remain in a spacious opening within it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sun's daily arc skirts opposite flanks instead of traversing the occupied center. Cave shelter and an internal gap therefore coexist: the place is open enough to be spatially legible yet arranged to avoid direct passage across the sleepers.

activation_trace.role: Literal sunrise starts the first half of the daily protective route.
Inclining and turning aside diverts the rising path from the cave interior.
The refuge image makes the diverted light function as shelter rather than mere geometry.
The literal right side fixes one flank of the route.
Literal sunset initiates the complementary half of the daily route.
Cutting across a place and passing to a side carries the setting path past rather than through them.
The literal left side supplies the route's opposite flank.
A wide interval between sides supplies the protected central volume.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a cave whose occupants happen not to receive direct sunlight.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a coherent preservation mechanism: a daily solar route bypasses both flanks of a spacious but sheltered center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The observable solar arrangement is called a sign, then immediately restated through guidance, deviation, finding, guardianship, and right direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse converts visible topology into a guidance topology. A route can be directed or lost; access can be found or fail; and a managing protector can supply right direction. The closing maxim therefore interprets the spatial scene rather than merely appending an unrelated doctrine.

activation_trace.role: Eye-perception frames the spatial mechanism as inspectable evidence.
A manifest mark promotes the observed route from scenery to sign.
Gentle direction toward a way maps the solar route onto divine guidance.
Departure from aim supplies the failed-route counterpart to guidance.
Finding the sought object turns failed guidance into failed access.
Management of another's affair names the protective agency that cannot be independently found.
Straight wayfinding names the corrective direction supplied by the absent guide.

changed_reading.before: A moral maxim about guidance follows a physical wonder.
changed_reading.after: The physical wonder is itself an enacted diagram of guidance: routed movement, protected access, loss, finding, and right direction form one mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths seek refuge, mercy, and right management; guidance is then increased, and the promised mercy is spread as a useful facility. The focus verse supplies the material implementation: cave, lateral solar passage, and a spacious interior make mercy operable as habitat.

activation_trace.role: The refuge image supplies the place in which requested mercy becomes spatially effective.
Passing to a side supplies the light-routing operation that makes the refuge usable.
The wide interval supplies habitable interior space rather than total enclosure.
Joining a sheltering direction establishes refuge as the requested action.
Correct handling of an affair makes the prayer concern workable arrangement, not information alone.
Added gentle direction links the answered prayer to the focus verse's guidance claim.
Opening and spreading gives mercy an expansive spatial action inside the refuge.
Utility and benefit identify the prepared result as a usable provision.

structural_cues: The prayer in 18:10 asks for mercy and right handling before 18:16 promises spread mercy and a prepared facility.
The focus verse immediately shows how that facility works without adding a separate object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge, requested right management, spread mercy, utility, and the solar bypass; I identify the bypassing cave environment as the causal delivery of that mercy. A live alternative is that the mercy remains general and the geometry is only one independent sign.

changed_reading.before: The cave geometry preserves the sleepers as an isolated physical marvel.
changed_reading.after: The geometry is the spatial answer to their prayer: mercy and guidance arrive as a prepared, usable environment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sunrise and sunset continue to articulate days outside sleepers whose experienced duration collapses. The surrounding sequence repeatedly attempts to count years, days, hundreds, and nine, then reserves full knowledge to God. The visible solar route is thus an external clock around subjects removed from ordinary time-awareness.

activation_trace.role: Recurring sunrise supplies one observable boundary of each external day.
Recurring sunset supplies the complementary boundary of each external day.
The year branch expands the repeated daily route into long measured duration.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning makes elapsed time an explicit problem.
A day or part-day supplies the sleepers' drastically compressed estimate.
The hundred-count supplies the long public measure absent from the sleepers' awareness.
The explicit nine sharpens the surrounding concern with exact duration.
Knowledge as disclosure assigns final temporal comprehension to God.

structural_cues: 18:11-12 introduces years and the contest of counting; 18:19 compresses felt time to a day or less; 18:25-26 returns to totals and divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated rise-set cycle and escalating failures or limits of duration-reckoning; I treat the solar motion as an external clock, not as a claim that anyone counted its cycles. It may instead function only as exposure control.

changed_reading.before: The solar movement regulates exposure during one depicted day.
changed_reading.after: The same movement also traces vast elapsed time outside sleepers whose internal clock has effectively stopped.

context_deltas.mechanism: The solar route and the sleepers' bodies are both worked across the same right-left pair. Environmental bypass and bodily turning form coupled cycles, so preservation is presented as sustained care operating around and upon them rather than as static storage.

activation_trace.role: Solar turning aside supplies the environmental motion.
The focus verse's right flank establishes the first shared directional pole.
Passing across to a side gives the environmental cycle lateral transit.
The focus verse's left flank establishes the second shared directional pole.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies the bodily counter-cycle.
The repeated right side aligns bodily turning with the solar route.
The repeated left side completes the alignment of the two cycles.

structural_cues: The exact right-left pair recurs in adjacent 18:17 and 18:18, first for sunlight and then for bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel directional pairs and two kinds of turning; I infer coordinated preservation from their adjacency and symmetry. The live alternative is that solar avoidance and bodily turning are independent signs.

changed_reading.before: The sun avoids the sleepers while they remain inert.
changed_reading.after: Preservation is dynamic and coupled: the environment turns around them while their bodies are turned within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Approach to the cave is first deflected by fear; exposure to the hostile community would be ruinous; only afterward are the sleepers deliberately caused to be found so that a truth becomes public. The focus sequence of hiddenness, finding, guardianship, and sign can therefore be read as control over when protected evidence is accessible.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies the focus scene's first visible pattern of deflected approach.
Hiddenness activates a material register of misguidance as failed discoverability.
Finding a sought object names the access that no independent protector can secure.
The visible sign supplies the purpose for eventual disclosure.
Looking in and uncovering the matter supplies an attempted breach of the hidden interior.
Turning away makes the would-be observer repeat the scene's deflection.
Flight converts deflection into effective exclusion.
Fear supplies the force that keeps premature observers out.
Overpowering exposure establishes why early discovery would destroy the protected state.
Being brought upon what was hidden supplies the later, purposeful disclosure.

structural_cues: 18:18 turns an approaching observer away, 18:20 names the danger of hostile access, and 18:21 then causes public discovery for an evidentiary purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deflected inspection, danger from exposure, and later caused discovery; I infer a staged access-control mechanism under divine management. The materially live alternative keeps ض ل ل moral and treats the discoveries as separate narrative events.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance and failure to find a guardian are purely moral abstractions.
changed_reading.after: They also resonate with the story's managed discoverability: protected evidence remains inaccessible until its disclosure can function as a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens with something directly visible and calls it a sign. Later discourse rejects guessed enumeration of the unseen, limits dispute to what is apparent, and closes by assigning complete seeing, hearing, and judgment to God. The solar scene models warranted observation without granting mastery of hidden duration or state.

activation_trace.role: Direct eye-perception establishes the warranted observational base.
A visible mark makes the observed pattern evidentiary without making every hidden fact available.
Guessing at the unseen marks the prohibited leap beyond observed evidence.
Concealment from eyes defines the domain that the visible solar sign does not disclose.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the social form of overclaiming beyond evidence.
Divine sight supplies complete observation beyond the human viewer's bounded scene.
Divine hearing adds a mode of access not available from the visible geometry alone.
Sole judgment separates legitimate witnessing from sovereign determination.

structural_cues: 18:22 opposes apparent evidence to unseen guessing; 18:26 reserves unseen knowledge and rule to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct seeing, visible sign, unseen guessing, and divine sensory and judicial scope; I infer that the opening 'you see' teaches an epistemic boundary. It may alternatively be rhetorical vividness without methodological force.

changed_reading.before: The viewer is shown enough of the miracle to understand what happened.
changed_reading.after: The viewer is shown a real sign but also trained to stop at its evidentiary edge: visible mechanism does not confer knowledge of the unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: After a regular daily solar route and a categorical guidance contrast, the context interrupts confident claims about tomorrow, inserts divine willing, repairs forgetting through remembrance, and asks for a nearer right course. Guidance becomes recurrent correction within time rather than a route autonomously possessed once for all.

activation_trace.role: The predictable appearance of sunrise supplies the apparent regularity against which future certainty is tested.
Gentle direction to a way supplies guidance as an ongoing directed relation.
Right wayfinding names the corrective aim of recalibration.
Divine willing conditions the asserted future route.
Restoring something after lapse supplies the correction operation.
Loss from memory supplies the deviation that requires repair.
Nearness turns right direction into a comparative approach rather than a static possession.
Requested direction carries the focus guidance claim into future correction.
The repeated right-way branch names the nearer course being sought.

structural_cues: 18:23 asserts tomorrow; 18:24 conditions that assertion, repairs forgetting, and asks for a nearer right course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regular solar motion, conditioned futurity, forgetting, remembrance, and nearer right direction; I infer iterative route-correction as their common mechanism. The alternative is a narrower etiquette of future speech unrelated to the solar scene.

changed_reading.before: The guided person occupies the correct path while the misguided person does not.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is also continual recalibration: even amid visible regularity, the next step depends on divine willing, remembered orientation, and movement toward a nearer right course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the book's straightness contrast into solar geometry. It remains anchored in the focus roots for inclination, side-passage, guidance, and right direction, but downstream prose should present it as a functional analogy, not claim that the context directly labels the sun's path morally straight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sun reaches the protected result by inclining and passing aside, while the verse closes with guidance and right direction.

activation_trace.role: Physical inclination supplies the apparently indirect route.
Passing to a side makes the detour operational.
Straight wayfinding supplies the successful end toward which the oblique route works.
Semantic deviation from straightness distinguishes defective crookedness from useful physical turning.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the context's criterion of a properly ordered result.

changed_reading.before: A straight route is direct, while deviation signals error.
changed_reading.after: The focus scene allows an oblique trajectory to serve a straight purpose: turning aside is precisely how right-directed preservation succeeds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats the cave as a local environmental buffer against the exposed earth's stripping cycle. It remains anchored in sun, side-passage, refuge, and open-gap branches, but should be rendered as a material analogy rather than a claim about climate or vegetation inside the cave.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sunlight passes around a spacious refuge rather than directly across its occupants.

activation_trace.role: Sun and exposure supply the ambient environmental force.
Passing to the side meters that force around the occupied center.
Refuge supplies a bounded local exception to outside conditions.
The wide gap makes the buffer open and spatial rather than sealed.
Fertile ground supplies the exposed surface before its reversal.
Surface beauty supplies the temporary habitable state.
Testing that reveals condition makes environmental change diagnostically meaningful.
The bare face of the earth supplies the exposed endpoint.
Ground cut off from vegetation supplies the stripping image against which refuge stands.

changed_reading.before: The cave merely blocks direct heat.
changed_reading.after: The cave reads as a local buffer that admits space and cyclic light while sheltering life from the exposed surface's stripping tendency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps architectural permeability onto the envoy's social stealth. It remains anchored in cave, side-passage, and open-gap branches and is activated by looking, subtle concealment, and fine awareness; downstream prose should call it an analogy of selective access, not an engineered doorway claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sleepers occupy an open gap in a refuge while external light passes by without crossing them.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the protected side of the interface.
Passing beside rather than through supplies selective transit.
The wide opening prevents refuge from meaning absolute closure.
Directed inspection supplies the controlled outward probe.
Fineness and concealment make outward passage selective and low-visibility.
Fine awareness defines the detection that the envoy must avoid.

changed_reading.before: Safety requires complete separation from the outside.
changed_reading.after: Safety can operate through controlled permeability: light and an envoy may pass at the boundary while hostile detection is kept from the protected center.

strongest_changes: The solar geometry becomes the material delivery of requested mercy, right management, and useful refuge.
Repeated right-left language couples environmental motion with bodily turning as sustained preservation.
The hidden-to-found sequence turns guidance and failed finding into a controlled schedule of access and disclosure.
Visible solar evidence is paired with a firm boundary against claims about unseen count, duration, and rule.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses spatial routing, bodily preservation, elapsed time, discoverability, and epistemic restraint into one visible sign; repeated roots let the same cave be refuge, clock, access boundary, and guidance diagram without forcing those readings into a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not specify cave orientation or physical causation, so the precise microenvironment remains inferred.
The discoverability model depends on the hiddenness branch of ض ل ل alongside its grammatically nearer moral sense.
The solar-clock reading marks external recurrence but does not establish that any character counted those cycles.
The purposeful-detour, local-buffer, and selective-interface readings are analogical outliers and should remain explicitly qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Guidance appears as calibrated exposure.** `ء ل ه` B001 (“worship and the worshipped one”) anchors the signs’ agency in God, while the sun alternately avoids and grazes the cave. Later the unshielded eastern people face direct sun (18:90), and the barrier people receive engineered protection (18:93–97). I infer that divine guidance regulates contact rather than simply maximizing light. The spatial choreography becomes a model of measured care.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The exposed people at 18:90 and resistant barrier at 18:97 showed that guidance may regulate very different degrees of exposure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Measured solar passage as a protective allotment.** `ق ر ض/B002` is passing by while leaving something to one side, the overt spatial image in `تَقْرِضُهُمْ`; exploratory `ق ر ض/B003` is a repayable cut-off advance. Two ayat later, the youths send their silver `وَرِق` to obtain provision (18:19), while the sun’s right/left passage has already rationed exposure. I supply the analogy: a limited advance can preserve its recipient without transferring the source itself. The solar motion therefore reads as measured provision on account, not random avoidance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:19’s silver unexpectedly activated the advance/credit branch, making the sun’s side-passage resemble measured provision rather than avoidance alone.

baseline.text: Güneş doğduğunda mağaralarının sağına yöneldiğini, battığında ise onları soldan geçtiğini görürdün; onlar mağaranın geniş bir yerindeydiler. Bu, Allah'ın ayetlerindendir. Allah kimi doğru yola iletirse doğruyu bulan odur; kimi saptırırsa ona yol gösteren bir dost bulamazsın.

findings.text: Güneşe karşı örtüsüz bırakılan doğu halkı ve sonradan setle korunan toplulukla karşılaştırıldığında, mağaradaki güneş hareketi ilahi yol göstermenin teması koruyucu ölçüde ayarlayabildiğini gösterir.
Güneşin sınırlı temasının, kaynağı devretmeden gençleri koruyan ölçülü bir avans gibi işlediği düşünülebilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A communication becomes trustworthy when deviation is removed from its form and its recipients are prepared to follow a sound course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Straightness migrates from the shape of revelation into the posture of hearts and the practical route they seek.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Prepared Hearts Find the Sound Course
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Petition, divine stabilization, proof, and guidance repeatedly convert vulnerable interior states into a practicable direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: heart-binding `ر ب ط:B004/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; unjust deviation `ش ط ط:B002/m01`; compelling proof `س ل ط:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:10 (prepared guidance); 18:14-15 (hearts bound against an outrageous claim and the demand for proof); 18:17 (divine guidance); 18:24 (hope for a nearer sound course)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Guidance here is engineered readiness rather than abstract information. The heart is held firm, an affair is made workable, and deviant speech is tested by whether it possesses compelling warrant.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Refuge works by regulating passage across a boundary: persons enter, mercy and light reach them selectively, and hostile access is repelled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cave is neither sealed nor simply open; it behaves as a selectively permeable shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Light Passes Without Violating the Shelter
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The sun's approach and departure are spatially deflected so that illumination passes around occupants held in the cave's open interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; inclined deviation `ز و ر:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش م ل:B006/m01`; broad interior gap `ف ج و:B001/m01`; broad cave `ك ه ف:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:17 (sunrise, sunset, right and left passage, and the occupants in the cave's opening)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is achieved through routing rather than total exclusion. The light remains active, but its trajectory is made compatible with the sleepers' preservation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sunrise and sunset define exposure conditions that are actively routed or governed rather than treated as neutral scenery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sun links private refuge to public rule by making exposure a condition that calls for calibrated response.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Cave Routes Solar Passage Around Vulnerable Bodies
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rising and setting light is diverted across the cave's sides while the sleepers remain in its broad opening.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; sheltering cave `ك ه ف:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:17 (sunrise, sunset, routed passage, and cave shelter)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Solar movement is compatible with protection because its contact is spatially managed. Exposure is neither total nor absent.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

root_profile.summary: Kök, suya kanma ve su taşıma çevresinden söz aktarma, düşünerek değerlendirme, ihtiyaç, kalan miktar, yük bağı, yapı bağımlı dolgunluk, görünüş, koku, hayvan, bayrak, uyak harfi, yağmur bulutu ve toplumsal yük taşıyan önderlere uzanan çok sayıda bağımsız dal içerir. Dalların bir bölümü su, taşıma ve doluluk benzetileriyle tarihsel olarak ilişkilendirilebilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında ayrı sınırlar gerektirir.

concept_gloss.text: suya kanma ve içeni kandıran su

contextual_glosses.text: içene yeten tatlı ve bol su

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki güneşi, onun görünen yuvarlak yüzünü ve yayılan ışığını aynı çekirdekte toplar; ayrıca günün güneşli oluşunu, bir şeyin güneşte yapılmasını ve kişinin güneşe çıkmasını belirli biçim ve kuruluşlarla bildirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ayrımları doğru biçimde kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın güneş anlamını merkezde tutar; günün güneşli olması, güneşte yapılma ve güneşe yönelme anlamlarını ise tanıklanan biçim ve söz öbekleriyle sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Gökte görülen güneş, onun yuvarlak yüzü ve ondan yayılan ışık bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Belirli kuruluşlarda bir günün bütünüyle güneşli olması, bir şeyin güneşte yapılması ve kişinin güneşe çıkıp ona yönelmesi de anlatılır.

facets.statement: Güneş, gökteki bilinen cisim, onun görünen yuvarlak yüzü ve çevreye yayılan ışığıdır.
Güneşli gün kuruluşu, gündüzünün bütünü güneşli olan günü ve günün güneşinin güçlenmesini bildirir.
Türetilmiş biçimler, bir şeyin güneşte yapılmasını ya da kişinin güneşe çıkıp ona yönelmesini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar güneşi hem gökteki cisim ve görünen yuvarlak yüz hem de ondan yayılan ışık olarak verir. Aynı kanıt kümesi, güneşli günü ve güneşte yapılma ya da güneşe çıkma bildiren bağlı kullanımları da içerir.

concept_gloss.text: güneş, güneş diski ve ışığı; güneşli olma ve güneşe çıkma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, yalın gök cismi çekirdeğiyle tanıklanan güneşli olma ve güneşe yönelme kullanımlarının tümünü birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Gök cismini, görünen diski, yayılan ışığı ve kuruluşlara bağlı güneşli olma ya da güneşe çıkma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gök cisminin, görünen yuvarlak yüzünün veya bağlama göre ondan yayılan ışığın kastedildiği kullanımlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın gök cismi ve bağlama bağlı disk ya da ışık çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Günün güneşli olması, güneşte yapılma ve kişinin güneşe çıkması gibi bağlı kullanımları tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Günün bütün gündüz boyunca güneşli olduğu ya da güneşinin güçlendiği kuruluşlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşte yapılma ve güneşe çıkıp yönelme anlamlarını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, güneşin yanı sıra tanın, yıldızın ve ayın doğmasını; ayrıca bu doğuşun kendisini ve gerçekleştiği yeri aynı dalda açıkça toplar. Bu nedenle dalın ışık veren gök varlıklarının belirmesi ve doğuş yeri biçimindeki çerçevesi kaynakla uyumludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca verilen gök varlığı ve tan ifadelerine bağlı olarak tanımlanır; genel bir yükselme ya da görünme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneşin, ayın, yıldızın veya tanın görünür duruma gelerek doğmasıdır; aynı ad doğuş olayını ve doğuşun gerçekleştiği yeri de gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Güneş, ay ve yıldız gibi ışık veren gök varlıkları görünür duruma gelerek doğar.
Tan yerinin aydınlanıp belirmesi de aynı doğuş olayı içinde anlatılır.
Aynı ad, kaynaklardaki biçim ayrımına göre doğuş olayını veya doğuş yerini gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar güneşin, ayın, yıldızın ve tanın doğuşunda birleşir. Ayrıca aynı sözün hem doğma olayına hem de gök varlığının doğduğu yere uygulanabildiğini birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: güneşin, ayın, yıldızın veya tanın doğması; doğuş olayı ve yeri

branches.source_phrase_ar: المطلع الموضع الذي تطلع عليه الشمس؛ والمطلع مصدر من طلع (ayn)؛ طلعت الشمس والكوكب طلوعا ومطلعا؛ والمطلع موضع طلوعها (sihah)؛ طلعت الشمس؛ وكذلك طلع الفجر والنجم والقمر؛ المطلع بالفتح هو الطلوع والمطلع بالكسر هو الموضع (tahdhib)؛ طلع الشمس طلوعا ومطلعا؛ والمطلع موضع الطلوع (mufradat)؛ أصل واحد صحيح يدل على ظهور وبروز؛ طلعت الشمس طلوعا ومطلعا؛ والمطلع موضع طلوعها (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bakıp öğrenme, başkasına gösterip bildirme, başı görünür kılma ve birinin görüşünü yoklama işlemlerini aynı dalda verir. Bunlar tek bir katılımcı düzenine indirgenemeyeceği için dal, görünür veya bilinir kılma ortaklığı korunarak ve katılımcı değişimleri açıkça ayrılarak kabul edilebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen bakma, öğrenme, gösterme ve görüş yoklama kuruluşlarına bağlıdır; genel bilgi edinme ya da açıklama anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye bakarak onun iç yüzünü öğrenmek veya onu başkasına görünür ya da bilinir kılmaktır; birinin görüşünü araştırma ve başı dışarı çıkarıp gösterme de bu kuruluşlara bağlı özel işlemlerdir.

facets.statement: Gözlemleyen kişi bir şeye yukarıdan bakar ya da iç yüzüne erişerek onu bütünüyle öğrenir.
Bilgiyi bilen kişi, bir işi veya saklı sözü başkasına göstererek onun da bilmesini sağlar.
Bir kişinin başını dışarı çıkarıp görünür kılması, fiziksel gösterme alt kullanımını oluşturur.
Birinin ne düşündüğünü anlamak için görüşünü araştırmak, bilgi edinme işleminin özel bir uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar bir şeyi gözleyip iç yüzünü öğrenme ile bilinen şeyi başkasına gösterip bildirme yönlerini birlikte verir. Başı görünür kılma, bir metni inceleme ve birinin görüşünü yoklama bu ortak görünürlük ve bilgi edinme düzeninin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi öğrenmek ya da başkasına gösterip bildirmek; görüşünü yoklamak
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin iç yüzüne erişme, onu başka bir kişiye açma veya birinin düşüncesini araştırma kuruluşlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öğrenme ve bildirme yönlerini, fiziksel göstermeyi ve görüş araştırmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bir işin iç yüzüne erişip onu öğrendiği bağlamda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözlemleyenin bir iş hakkında kapsamlı bilgi edinmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasına gösterme, başı görünür kılma ve görüş yoklama alt kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başı göstermeyi, görüş yoklamayı ve açık bir şeyi incelemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bilginin özellikle gizli olmasını ve gizliye birden erişme yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal saklı bir işi öğrenmeyi ve başkasının da öğrenmesini sağlamayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kuruluşları fiziksel gösterme ile görüş araştırmaya kadar uzanır; komşu dal ise gizli bilgiye erişme sınırına daha sıkı bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal öğrenilmiş şeyi başkasına gösterip bildirme ve başı görünür kılma işlemlerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal soru sormayı, haber aramayı ve geniş çaplı araştırmayı temel işlem yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bilinmeyen bir iş hakkında bilgi edinmeye yönelebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bakarak iç yüze erişme ve görünür kılma düzenindedir; komşu dalın çekirdeği soruşturma ve haber aramadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular incelendi; gizli bilgiye erişme ile soruşturma alanları, dalın öğrenme ve gösterme sınırlarını en açık biçimde ayırdığı için seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الاطلاع على الشيء أو باطن الأمر، وإظهار الرأس، وإطلاع غيرك على السر أو الأمر، واستطلاع الرأي
branches.source_phrase_ar: أطلع فلان رأسه أظهره؛ اطلع أشرف على الشيء؛ أطلع غيره إطلاعا؛ أطلعني طلع هذا الأمر حتى علمته كله؛ استطلعت رأيه (ayn)؛ اطلعت على باطن أمره؛ طالعت الشيء أي اطلعت عليه؛ أطلعتك على سري؛ استطلعت رأي فلان (sihah)؛ اطلع فلان إذا أشرف على شيء؛ أطلع غيره؛ استطلعت رأي فلان إذا نظرت ما رأيه؛ أطلعني فلان (tahdhib)؛ اطلع؛ أطلع الغيب؛ أطلعتك على كذا؛ واستطلعت رأيه (mufradat)؛ أطلعتك على الأمر إطلاعا؛ أطلعتك طلعه؛ استطلعت رأي فلان إذا نظرت ما الذي يبرز إليك منه (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الطليعة والطلائع الذين يبعثون لينظروا طلع العدو
يدخل فيه طلع النخلة وطلعتها، وإطلاع النخل، وظهور الزرع إذا بدا
يدخل فيه طلوع الجبل وعلوه، والمطلع مصعدا أو موضع إشراف أو مأتى ووجها للأمر
يدخل فيه طلاع الأرض بمعنى ملئها أو ما استوعبته الشمس، وطلاع الكف، والقدح أو العين الممتلئة
يدخل فيه النفس الطلعة التي تتطلع إلى الشيء، والمرأة الطلعة القبعة التي تظهر وتنظر ثم تختبىء
يدخل فيه الطلعة بمعنى الرؤية أو هيئة الإنسان حين ترى
يدخل فيه السهم الطالع أو إطلاع الرامي إذا ارتفع السهم وجاوز الغرض أو وقع وراءه
يدخل فيه أطلع إذا قاء، والطلعاء أو الطولع بمعنى القيء
يدخل فيه النخلة المطلعة إذا طالت ما حولها، والهطلع الرجل الطويل مع الهاء الزائدة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlamın çekirdeğini bir doğrultudan yana eğilme, amaçlanan yönden ayrılma ve başka yana dönme olarak açıkça kurar. Çöl, kuyu, kap ve yay örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı fiziksel gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı olmayan eğilme ve yön değiştirme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılması, başka yana dönmesi veya fiziksel olarak yana eğilmesidir. Bu çekirdek, eğri biçimli nesnelere ve bakış ya da duruştaki yana kaymaya uygulanabilir.

facets.statement: Amaçlanan yön, yol veya duruştan yana doğru ayrılma ve başka tarafa dönme.
Bir nesnenin biçiminde, bir canlının duruşunda veya bakışında fiziksel yana eğrilik bulunması.
Yolundan uzaklaşmış arazi, dibi uzak kuyu, eğri kap ve yay bu yönelme biçiminin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yön veya amaç çizgisinden ayrılma ile fiziksel yana eğilmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; nesne ve duruş örnekleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılmayı hem de fiziksel yana eğrilik gösteren yalın kullanımları birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yön değişmesi, amaçtan ayrılma ve fiziksel eğilme çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne, gövde veya bakışın fiziksel olarak bir yana kaydığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yana kayma ve eğrilik anlamını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin amaçlanan rota veya doğrultudan ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Amaçlanan yönden ayrılma ve başka yana dönme anlamını korur.
